title: Pointwise Gibbs inequality
statement: For real numbers $q,y,Z$ with $q\ge 0$ and $Z>0$, one has $qy-q\log Z-q\log q\le e^y/Z-q$, where the term $q\log q$ is interpreted using the usual continuous convention at $q=0$.
